conclusion: Shared support/Brim visibility queries now use bounded parallel read-only clipping with original serial graph relaxation and tie order. Brim.cpp itself remains unchanged. All existing model, first-plane, Brim and contact bead instructions in repeated test2 exports exactly match the previously verified output, including 0.17mm contacts. Original Release/data_dir remains unchanged and all 852 files survive controlled builds. Full native support/Brim regression passes.
scope: Verified exact-output organic support performance on two existing 3MF fixtures and complete selected native support/Brim cases. Does not establish a universal speedup, a new upstream integration, installation or publication.
